title: Apple iPhone 17 Pro 256GB (All Colours) $1732 + Del ($0 to Metro/ OnePass/ C&C/ In Select Stores) @ Officeworks (Ex QLD, WA, NT)
body:
Deal: Apple iPhone 17 Pro 256GB (All Colours) $1732 + Del ($0 to Metro/ OnePass/ C&C/ In Select Stores) @ Officeworks (Ex QLD, WA, NT)

[stickyfingers] Consider it a blessing, what an awful colour for a phone.
[djmm] If you like the colour orange, you will like the iphone with the colour orange
[sn0w] Same price for deep blue on Amazon for everyone excluded: https://amzn.asia/d/0bu4Fdeu
[AsahiConnect] I bought this via MWave at $1900 AUD thinking its a good deal, waiting 1 month for order to be fulfilled and nothing happened, got a refund after 5 days…. it was a painful journey.
I then returned my DBrand, brand new phone case and screen protector for a full refund because i thought, hey, 1800-1900 is the cheapest possible price this thing will get to…..so i justified, 2300-2400 is what i'd buy a new 18 pro max for with any rises going in and snapping it from costco….. I'm so tempted to buy this and rebuy a DBrand case…..the bigger battery and more efficient network chip though on 18….
[JoeBogan] So close to the 18 releasing, I’d wait my dude
[davidinho] Mwave is finished as a retailer don't bother
[JAF] Bought the blue 17 pro max last December (silver was a 2-3 week back order) and absolutely hate the colour and have wanted silver ever since. I’m so tempted to get that silver 17 pro 256gb but an extra $500 (OW $1195 trade in value for 17pm) for a colour change is so stupid
[OzBed] Orange will be good for like a week, blue for a day max. Always go for the silver.
[dlakers3peat] I just paid $1,804.99 today for the 17 256gb pro max from ow. I would spend the extra over this deal.
[Ace26] Just curious on how you achieved this price? I am not looking to buy one, I just posted for anyone keen on price protection claim
[dlakers3peat] Ow price beat costco. But ow have now lowered their price to match costco so that's no longer possible.
[j3rk] @dlakers3peat: Ow lowered to match Costco price now
[Ace26] Pro max for sure (unless you have a very specific reason or just simply prefer a small size), you will get a lot more phone for additional $169
[KiwiBloke] 17 pro underrated choice. The feel and convenience of one handed use is hard to beat. Battery life is still great on it too.
Price being cheaper comes as a bonus
[mustery] This or wait for the 18 pro in September? Will the step up be worth the wait/price?
[derdew] every chance the price will be 30% higher. https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/iphone-pri…
[imaxsameer] It's tempting, but I will wait for the 18 Pro. It will have every improvement over the 17 Pro (coming from a 16 Pro)
